timeline.summary: ICRA reaffirmed Greenlam Industries' long-term bank facilities at [ICRA]AA- (Negative) and short-term facilities at [ICRA]A1+ on May 5, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹857.66 Cr (+25.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹39.46 Cr (+1797.1% YoY).

Greenlam Industries Limited’s Board of Directors, led by Senior Vice President-Legal Prakash Kumar Biswal, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.40 per equity share for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval on July 29, 2026.
Promoter Saurabh Mittal disclosed nil share encumbrance and 50.98% promoter holding as of March 31, 2026.
Greenlam Industries received a GST show cause notice for ₹7.71 Cr for FY 2023-24 and submitted its reply.
